rca.title: Race condition in session cache
rca.description: Simultaneous token refresh corrupts memory cache entries.
rca.root_cause: The global cache object is accessed and modified concurrently by multiple asynchronous refresh operations without proper synchronization, leading to race conditions.
rca.suggested_fix: Implement a locking mechanism or use a more suitable data structure like a concurrent map to ensure thread-safe operations on the cache.
rca.mechanism: Race condition due to unsynchronized access to shared resource

hypothesis_tree.mechanism: Race condition due to unsynchronized access to shared resource
supporting_evidence: src/cache/session.ts:4 - 'cache[id] = val;' indicates unsynchronized access to the global cache object.

hypothesis_tree.mechanism: Logical error in token fetching logic
contradicting_evidence: src/cache/session.ts:3 - 'const val = await fetchToken(id);' shows token fetching is awaited, indicating no logical error in fetching.
